main.description: The caller's contact email and notice settings, from their preferences space on HappyProto (at.happyproto.preferences/self). Only the caller's own. verified and pendingVerified say whether each address is proven to be theirs, by their PDS at sign-in or by a link. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

email.description: The contact email in use. Absent when there is none: never set, or removed.

verified.description: Whether email is proven to be the caller's. HappyProto mails only a proven address.

pendingEmail.description: An address waiting for its link to be opened. Until then email stays in use.

pendingVerified.description: Whether pendingEmail's link has been opened; present with pendingEmail. It becomes email at the next change or sign-in.

maintenance.description: Whether the caller gets maintenance emails. True until they turn it off.
